purpose: Teach: 間際/色合い/メシ/大いなる/不可解/非常識/あきらか/捜し

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは出発間際に決意を語ったぞ
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, your father — he spoke his resolve right before he left.
lines.style: Slow, measured delivery. Voice lands gently on each memory. Slight pause before 'resolve' — reaching back through decades. Quiet reverence, not sadness.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、絵の色合いに敏感でいらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes — and Grandpa, you were always so sensitive to the colors in a painting, weren't you?
lines.style: Warm, meandering. Gentle tilt upward on the question. A wife noticing her husband noticing things. Soft affection in the correction — she's guiding him back.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、村のメシ屋でお父さんが食事されたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, your father — he ate at the little village restaurant.
lines.style: Same measured pace as before. Voice settles on the ordinary detail as if it holds weight. A small pivot away from her question, back to his thread.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、大いなるご決断をされたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa, you made such an important decision that day, didn't you?
lines.style: Patient, following his lead without pushing. The question is gentle — she knows he's circling something. Warm but attentive, like she's giving him space to land.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが不可解な人物に遭遇されたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, your father — he met someone very strange.
lines.style: Slight quickening of pace. The memory catches a little — something puzzling still. Voice carries a thread of unresolved curiosity. Not quite the same peace as the other memories.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、非常識な振る舞いに、お怒りだったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa, you were upset by how rude they behaved, weren't you?
lines.style: Softer this time, almost a whisper of understanding. She's not asking about the rudeness — she's asking if he remembers being moved by it. Tender protection in her voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんはあきらかに優しい人だったぞ
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, your father — he was clearly a gentle man.
lines.style: Voice steadies and deepens. This memory has certainty. Delivered with quiet conviction. The pieces seem to be coming together for him. Warm finality, not closure.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、夜遅くまで子どもを捜してくださったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa, you searched for that child all through the night, didn't you?
lines.style: Intimate, almost a whisper. Voice full of love for this act — this proof of him. The question dissolves gently at the end, trailing into knowing silence. Her hand reaching across time.
